parts.label: (i)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Carry out relevant method to find $A$ and $B$ such that $\frac1{4-y^2}\equiv\frac{A}{2+y}+\frac{B}{2-y}$ - M1. Obtain $A=B=\frac14$ - A1. Total: 2.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Separate variables correctly and integrate at least one side to obtain one of the terms $a\ln x$, $b\ln(2+y)$ or $c\ln(2-y)$ - M1. Obtain term $\ln x$ - B1. Integrate and obtain terms $\frac14\ln(2+y)-\frac14\ln(2-y)$ - A1FT. Use $x=1$ and $y=1$ to evaluate a constant, or as limits, in a solution containing at least two terms of the form $a\ln x$, $b\ln(2+y)$ and $c\ln(2-y)$ - M1. Obtain a correct solution in any form, e.g. $\ln x=\frac14\ln(2+y)-\frac14\ln(2-y)-\frac14\ln3$ - A1. Rearrange as $\frac{2(3x^4-1)}{3x^4+1}$, or equivalent - A1. Total: 6.
